name: Alaska Airlines Visa Signature
notes: Bank of America's August 20, 2025 announcement explicitly says the Alaska Airlines Visa Signature card transforms into Atmos Rewards Ascent Visa Signature. Existing benefits continue without interruption; replacement card faces arrive at expiration. The announcement date does not establish the exact application-withdrawal date, which is unknown. Historical fees/rewards and the credit-limit-tier note are retained, not re-verified. No successor artwork is used. Card art provenance (checked 2026-10-21, secondary source, lower confidence): no usable official issuer image was found, so this is a local upload under the repo's option-C convention (image.provenance.source "other"; the sha256 is of the downloaded file). The source page is listed in secondary_sources. Match: Alaska Airlines Mileage Plan Visa Signature face shown for the Alaska Airlines Visa Signature card on NerdWallet's airline-card page (archived 2018-05-15), Bank of America era. The artwork remains the copyright of the issuer; it is for identification only and is not evidence of lifecycle or financial fields.
